html: סמם (√ of foll.; meaning dub.; if akin to Arabic شَمَّ smell Lane 1593, مَشْمُومٌ any fragrant plant Id 1594, then ס must be for שׂ; in that case ס׳ perhaps loan-word in Heb.; NH id.; spice, drug (Ecclus שׂ׳ 38:4 m.); Aramaic סַמָּא id., ܣܰܡܳܐ drug, pigment; Arabic سَمٌّ poison is appar. loan-word Frä262).
